reason_for_amendment: The exact-binding and reconstruction-feasibility audits established before P01B metrics that the final NeoPolyp semantic-transition caches were not preserved, while the SOURCE state is exactly reconstructable. The four-feature simple mask-change descriptor was already frozen in the parent P01B protocol. Therefore the core framework experiment is restricted to SOURCE_STATE versus SOURCE_PLUS_SIMPLE_MASK_CHANGE, with the already-frozen R33 full semantic-transition score retained only as a historical reference when exact binding succeeds.
scientific_question: On PolypGen unseen MEMO, does candidate-conditioned geometric change improve future-HARM ranking beyond a matched SOURCE-state-only model trained on the same NeoPolyp TENT1 + PL-CONF90 rows?

SOURCE_PLUS_SIMPLE_MASK_CHANGE.boundary_density: number of vertical + horizontal adjacent-pixel disagreements divided by ((H-1)W + H(W-1)); identical definition to B6-P01A

representations.FROZEN_FULL_TRANSITION_SAFETTA: optional historical reference only; no refit. Exact R33 risk-score binding required.

interpretation.framework_support: Primary paired AUROC delta > 0 with CI excluding 0, together with AUPRC not worsening, supports incremental candidate-conditioned information on the second task.
interpretation.negative_result_rule: If the geometry model does not improve over SOURCE state, report the null/negative result; do not alter geometry features, threshold, action support, model, or score direction.

forbidden: No geometry+semantic fusion designed from PolypGen outcomes.
No use of semantic-only source features reconstructed by a new DINO replay in this experiment.
